text:
margo: Heads-up team: initiating a SHORT RELEASE FREEZE for the release train due to a critical security patch that needs coordinated deploys across infra and runtime. Effective immediately (45m target). Hold non-critical merges and feature rollouts.

lin: Acknowledged. Which services are in-scope?

margo: In-scope: runtime agents, model-serving infra, and the telemetry agent. Not in-scope: static docs + client SDK doc patches (but hold SDK binary releases).

nina: Security confirms CVE-2026-1024 affects the telemetry agent build on kernel 5.12. Patch available but requires synchronized rollout to avoid mismatched metrics schema. See: https://intra/redwood/security/advisories/CVE-2026-1024 

jules: Oncall SRE here. Spinning canary group ci-sec-canary-01 with patched agent now. Running smoke and schema checks.

devops-bot: CI: pipeline triggered -> sec-patch-rollout (canary) at 2026-03-24T09:12:45Z. Artifacts: runtime-agent-1.4.2-patch.

lin: Ill pause the current release queue and move PRs tagged "low-priority" out to next train.

margo: Triage checklist:
- validate canary (15m)
- ensure telemetry schema compatibility (nina)
- coordinate infra image updates (devops)
- hold release train updates until canary green

kevin: Product note: notify enterprise customers with the scheduled freeze line: "We are performing a brief, coordinated security roll to address an agent issue; service continuity expected; no API changes." I can draft the message.

jules: Canary results: CPU and p99 latency normal, telemetry schema validation PASS. Leaving canary under observation for another 10m.

margo: Good. Keep freeze in place until we confirm stable for 20m post-canary. No non-security deploys in that window.

deploy-bot: Rolling update started: sec-patch-rollout -> targets: infra-pool-a, infra-pool-b at 2026-03-24T09:28:03Z.

devops-bot: INFO: image pushed -> runtime-agent-1.4.2-patch:sha256:abcd1234 at 2026-03-24T09:30:11Z

nina: Verified metrics - no schema drift. All good from security side. Recommend lifting freeze after 20m stable window.

margo: UPDATE 09:52Z - 20m stable achieved. Lifting release freeze. Resume normal release cadence but keep the sec-patch gating in infra CI for the next 48h.

lin: Ill unpause the release queue and re-enqueue low-priority PRs.

kevin: Customer note sent to affected accounts.

margo: Thanks everyone. Retro scheduled tomorrow 11:00 to capture lessons: add gating checks for telemetry schema in release automation and document kernel compatibility matrix.

jules: Closing incident; adding runbook notes.

margo: End of thread.
